aboutText: At Built By Wood, we bring passion and precision to every carpentry project in Reservoir. With a focus on quality materials and attention to detail, our experienced team handles everything from bespoke furniture to full home renovations. We are committed to exceeding expectations for homeowners and businesses across Melbourne.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of carpentry services tailored to Reservoir homes and businesses. From custom built-ins to outdoor decking, our skilled team ensures every project is completed to the highest standard.
